long_biography.plain_text:
Laura Nazor built her career in coastal tourism from Jesenice, near Split. By 2006 she was the registered owner of a tour-operator business trading as Lion Queen Charter. The agency specialised in Croatian gulet holidays, combining booking and itinerary planning with transfers, parking arrangements and guest support before and during each cruise.

Nazor positioned the company as a dedicated Croatian cruise specialist rather than a general travel agency. Its materials set out multilingual reservation procedures, staged payments and tailored arrangements for small-group Adriatic itineraries. The sole-trader operation ceased trading in March 2019, ending more than a decade of activity under Nazor's ownership.
